name: Seplat
source: CRON 2026-10-07: rebuilt from the audited FY2025 annual report already held at _ngx_pdf/SEPLAT.pdf. Group consolidated statement of profit or loss, printed page 54 (PDF page 55), for cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit and finance cost net for FY2025 and FY2024; audited group five-year financial summary, printed page 163 (PDF page 164), for revenue, profit before taxation, income tax and profit for FY2025 to FY2021, all in NGN million. Operating Expenses is derived: gross profit plus other income and the bargain purchase gain less operating profit. The values previously stored in the FY2024 to FY2021 columns were the naira FY2025 and FY2024 columns and the two US dollar columns of printed page 54, shifted down the period list, so every cell from FY2024 back was misassigned or in the wrong currency. Unit: naira (printed NGN million x 1,000,000). | CRON 2026-10-07 NGX Q2 2026 filing fill: Unaudited condensed consolidated interim statement of profit or loss, half year ended 30 June 2026 column, NGN millions stored as absolute naira. Revenue 2,502,181; Cost of sales 1,380,469; Gross profit 1,121,712; Operating profit 901,732; Finance cost net 106,999; Profit before taxation 790,415; Income tax expense 564,937; Profit for the period 225,478; Basic earnings per share 365.43 naira. Ties: 2,502,181 less 1,380,469 equals 1,121,712, and 790,415 less 564,937 equals 225,478. The EPS cell previously held 26.6, the US dollar cents figure from the same release; the file is a naira file so the naira EPS replaces it. Operating Expenses is stored as Gross Profit less Operating Profit to match the convention this file already uses for FY2025. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47641_SEPLAT_ENERGY_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Revenue - Cost of Sales does not equal the filed Gross Profit and no other identity in the file fixes which of the two is wrong; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT), and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

currencyCheck: Currency check 2026-09-27: the filing this file cites, Seplat_Energy_Plc_2025_AFS.pdf on NGX doclib, could not be read - its text layer is encoded with a custom font mapping and extracts as control bytes (166 of 206 pages yield text, none of it legible), so the currency the filing prints could NOT be confirmed or refuted from it and no value or currency field was changed. Two flags stand: (1) this file declares NGN while the stored magnitudes are mixed - Total assets 9,821,261,000 sits a factor of 1000 below Non-current assets 6,787,040,000,000 in the same file, so at least one of them is at the wrong scale; (2) the NGX-filed Seplat interim on disk (SEPLAT.pdf, half year to 30 June 2026) prints its statements in naira (₦ million), while Seplat annual reports are commonly published in US dollars. Both need a read of the AFS PDF itself, which this pass could not do.
